briefdescription.para: Verify that passing config["enable_deduplication"]=false skips the perceptual dedup check even when a DeduplicationChecker is attached.

detaileddescription.para: This validates the AC-4 requirement: deduplication is opt-in per collection via ContentPolicy; default off.

briefdescription.para: Verify that when enable_deduplication is absent from config (default), perceptual dedup is NOT performed even when a DeduplicationChecker is attached.

detaileddescription.para: This validates the "default off" requirement of AC-4: callers must opt in explicitly by passing config["enable_deduplication"]=true.

briefdescription.para: pHash performance: 4 MP BMP image must hash in < 5 ms (median over 20 runs).

detaileddescription.para: Performance target from acceptance criteria (roadmap:168:content:v1.8.0). Set THEMIS_RUN_PERF_TESTS=1 to enable.

briefdescription.para: MinHash + LSH lookup: warm band index of 100 K entries, 10 KB text, < 1 ms median.

detaileddescription.para: Performance target from acceptance criteria (roadmap:168:content:v1.8.0). Set THEMIS_RUN_PERF_TESTS=1 to enable.

briefdescription.para: Near-duplicate detection overhead: < 10% of total ingestion proxy latency.

detaileddescription.para: Measures the incremental cost of perceptual deduplication (pHash or MinHash + band-LSH lookup) relative to a baseline that only does exact-dedup (SHA-256). Uses the text path (MinHash) with a warm 100 K-entry band index to exercise the realistic worst-case lookup path.
Performance target from acceptance criteria (roadmap:168:content:v1.8.0, AC-8). Set THEMIS_RUN_PERF_TESTS=1 to enable.

briefdescription.para: Unit tests for content deduplication via perceptual hashing.

detaileddescription.para:
Covers:
ImageProcessor::computePHash() — DCT-based 64-bit hash
TextProcessor::computeMinHash() — 128-permutation MinHash
DeduplicationChecker — pHash Hamming distance and MinHash band-LSH
ContentMetrics — recordDedupCheck / recordDedupHit counters
